worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.summary: Creates a magnetic field that raises Defense and Special Defense for allied Plus/Minus Pokémon, iron golems, and bodies wearing metal armor. Leaving the field removes its gains.
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.use.0: Protect Plus/Minus partners and allies wearing metal armor
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.use.1: Plant a field under your side's Electric core
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.use.2: Pad both defenses before a wave of hits
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.descripti: The field covers a %1$s-block radius for %2$s.
Eligible allies gain %1$s Defense stages and %2$s Special Defense stages while the field and effect last.
Opposite: +1 more Defense and Sp. Def and a x1.2 longer field, but the field is x0.72 wide, +2 ticks telegraph, x1.12 cooldown.
Same: a x1.2 wider field, cheaper telegraph and cooldown, base stages and a shorter window.
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.timing: Self move, covering a %1$s block radius; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.growth.0: From level %1$s: field lasts %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.growth.1: From level %1$s: field lasts %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.magneticflux.preferenc: Opposite: +1 more Defense and Sp. Def and a x1.2 longer field, but the field is x0.72 wide, +2 ticks telegraph, x1.12 cooldown - shield a few key targets. Same: a x1.2 wider field, cheaper telegraph and cooldown, base stages and a shorter window - cover more allies.
